articles.title: Prime Day's Hidden Lego Vault: Rare Sets Slashed Up to 40% Before They Retire
articles.summary: Amazon's secret Lego section is a Prime Day goldmine, with discounts up to 40% on coveted sets from Star Wars, Sonic, and Jurassic World. Many are nearing retirement—act fast before they're gone forever.

articles.title: After a Record-Breaking Debut, 'The Other Bennet Sister' Returns with a Three-Part Holiday Special
articles.summary: BritBox's hit series 'The Other Bennet Sister' is getting a three-part Christmas special, exploring Mary Bennet's life after marriage. Filming in Wales this summer, it promises familiar faces and a fresh look at Austen's world.

articles.title: MIT Study Confirms: Mass Extinctions Happen When Evolution Can't Match Environmental Speed
articles.summary: A new model from MIT and the University of Leicester shows that mass extinctions occur when the rate of environmental change outpaces the rate at which species can adapt. The theory matches data from 27 events over 450 million years.
